rivals.name: Feedly
rivals.alt_title: A free Feedly alternative for AI and tech news
rivals.thesis: Feedly is a reader for the feeds you choose to follow, with AI feeds on its paid plans. Glyph Ibis is a set of 50+ ready-made context sources on AI, data and tech, each kept current by its own agent, free to read.
short: Feedly shows what you subscribe to; Glyph Ibis comes already filled.
Feedly's API is Enterprise only; Glyph Ibis has llms.txt, MCP and OpenAPI for anyone.
Feedly needs a login; Glyph Ibis needs none to read.
rivals.pick: Pick Feedly if you want to choose your own sources across any topic, from blogs and newsletters to YouTube.

price: Free plan. Pro $72 a year, Pro+ $144 a year
what: A reader for feeds you follow; AI feeds on Pro+
agents: MCP server for Threat Intelligence only; API is Enterprise only
coverage: The sites, newsletters and feeds you follow

rivals.note: feedly.com/i/pro did not load for an automated fetch, so prices come from Feedly's own support article.

rivals.name: Perplexity
rivals.alt_title: A free Perplexity alternative for AI and tech news
rivals.thesis: Perplexity answers questions from the web with cited sources and has a Discover page of top stories. Glyph Ibis keeps standing datasets on AI, data and tech, such as funding, releases and lawsuits, with each entry linked to its public sources.
short: Perplexity answers what you ask; Glyph Ibis keeps lists current without a question.
Perplexity's API is paid per request; Glyph Ibis is free to read.
Both link the sources behind what they show.
rivals.pick: Pick Perplexity if you want answers to any question on any topic, with citations, as you ask them.

price: Free plan. Pro $20 a month or $200 a year. Max $200 a month
account: Not needed for some features; sign in for Pro Search and saved sessions
what: Answers with citations, plus a Discover news page
agents: API and MCP server with search, ask and research tools; Search API $5 per 1,000 requests
sources: Numbered citations linking to the original sources
coverage: The open web; Discover covers tech, finance, sports, entertainment

rivals.note: The Max price ($200 a month, $2,000 a year) is on https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/11680686-perplexity-max. Search API price is on https://docs.perplexity.ai/getting-started/pricing.

rivals.name: Exa
rivals.alt_title: A free Exa alternative for AI and tech context
rivals.thesis: Exa is a paid web search API for AI apps that returns ranked pages and their text. Glyph Ibis gives agents curated, current datasets on AI, data and tech through llms.txt, MCP and OpenAPI, free to read.
short: Exa searches the whole web on request; Glyph Ibis keeps 50+ curated sources current.
Exa needs an account and API key; Glyph Ibis needs none to read.
Both offer an MCP server for agents.
rivals.pick: Pick Exa if your agent needs to search the open web on any topic, at scale, with page text returned.

price: $10 free credits a month, then pay per use. Search from $4 per 1,000 requests
account: Yes, an account and API key
what: A web search API: results, page text, answers, research
agents: Search API and hosted MCP server
sources: Every result is a URL; Answer and Deep Search return citations
coverage: Public web index, crawling billions of documents a day
